The Anthropic IPO is coming soon

For those who don't know, yes, this is 2026 ... there will be 2x long and 2x short Anthropic ETFs launched soon after the IPO

So for the people who trade 2x ETFs, here's what the 2x Anthropic tickers from my sponsors over at TradrETFs will be 

- 2x Long Anthropic: $ANTT 
- 2x Short Anthropic: $ATNZ

ANTHROPIC SET ITS IPO TERMS. 825M SHARES AT $70 TO $78
At the $74 midpoint that's a ~$968B company. Top of the range is $1.02T.

In January I had Anthropic at $230B to $300B in my 2026 IPO pipeline post. It's coming public at more than 3x that.

The S-1 backs it up. $33.2B of revenue in the first 9 months of 2026, 13x the same stretch last year, with a 12% adjusted operating margin.

Once $ANT lists, @TradrETFs is expected to launch $ANTT (2x long) and $ANTZ (2x short).

Be careful guys, leverage involves major risk. Read more at https://t.co/10FGPIs9n2.
